notes: v1.11: (1) Sell panel keyboard-friendly: Add Sale Enter moves Weight->Mode->Amount->Bill->Remarks->Save (it used to save straight from Weight), Ctrl+Enter saves from any field, Mode by 1-7 / first letter / arrows, focus returns to the Dashboard table after a sale/stock/return; Daily Entries: arrows select, C=Correct, V=Void, Enter=Correct, Enter in Date/Search loads. (2) Add Stock fix: Dashboard now has an Added column (stock adds were invisible after Remaining was removed) with inline editing like Sold/Return. (3) Reset button: Dashboard Reset Today + Daily Reset This Date — deletes every entry for that date plus that day's Excel file, other days untouched, safety backup made first, confirmation lists what will be deleted, locked Excel aborts before any deletion. Includes v1.10 (manual cell entry), v1.9 (table fix), v1.8 (crash-proof startup), v1.7 (empty Return), v1.6 (keyboard-first), v1.5 (GOLD/SILVER), v1.4 (client installer), v1.3 (sale Mode/Amount/Bill No.), v1.2 (no cmd window), v1.1 (Ramanand Jewellers, gold icon).
